Current UI: a floating 56px purple-to-blue gradient circular bubble bottom-right (visible in nearly every screenshot this session), opening a ~22rem × 30rem glass panel with a quick-reply funnel menu, transcript with plan/action cards, image attachments, typing indicators, live "bot step" labels, and a conversation-history overlay. It polls `/api/chat`, uploads via `/api/chat/upload`, and is a first-party live-chat/AI-agent hybrid (Tidio-style), not a mailto or dumb link.
